package cmd

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
)

func TestAuthenticationGRPCWithObjectStorageAndDisabledAuth(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := config.DefaultConfig()
	cfg.Storage.Type = config.ObjectStorageType
	cfg.Database.URL = "invalid database URL"

	registerers, interceptors, shutdown, err := authenticationGRPC(context.Background(), zap.NewNop(), cfg, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authenticationGRPC attempted a database connection: %v", err)
	}
	if len(registerers) != 2 || len(interceptors) != 0 || shutdown == nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected disabled authentication bootstrap: %d registerers, %d interceptors", len(registerers), len(interceptors))
	}
}
